adoption_scope: These three objects are accepted only as contextual, source-linked Wisdom inputs for Sourceborn architecture tests. They are not source text, doctrinal canon, universal law, permission, or autonomous action authority.

objects.name: Separate action-quality control from outcome ownership
objects.principle: When an actor has a legitimate action within its role but cannot guarantee the result, evaluate and improve the controllable quality of action separately from psychological or ownership claims over the final outcome.

objects.name: Do not let anticipated success or failure become the sole controller of action
objects.principle: Success/failure expectations may inform planning, but should not become the sole arbiter of whether a legitimate action is worth executing; maintain a stable decision state while continuing to observe evidence.

objects.name: Action-focus must remain coupled to discernment, skill and feedback
objects.principle: A principle favoring action over paralysis must not be reduced to blind execution; discernment, verification, failure feedback and skill remain part of competent action.

global_runtime_guards: Retrieval of a Wisdom Object never makes its applicability true by itself.
ASI-NODE-21 may accept, reject or narrow application but cannot convert interpretation into source truth.
A Wisdom Object cannot satisfy an authorization threshold.
A Wisdom Object cannot erase a failure signal or required return.
A Wisdom Object cannot be injected into a Human Actor View without a communication/access event.
Law formation, if ever requested, must be a separate Sequence.
